lines.t: November 24th, 2023
From the Lord, our God and Saviour
The Word of the Lord spoken to Timothy
For a brother in Messiah
A brother in Messiah asked,
Should I speak up about the lack of integrity at my workplace, or should I just leave?
Concerning those who struggle in the world of men and those who must remain in it,
striving to provide for those they love. I say this, whether one abides or departs,
it is acceptable with me. Only let my people rest and be set apart on the Sabbath day.
For I tell you the truth, no blame is placed upon those who stay quiet, when a wrong such as this
is of little consequence. The material is of no value, for this world is passing away. It is the
person and the heart of man I look upon, my beloved are of more value than silver and gold.
Therefore one need not stir up controversy, save when a person is in danger, for the integrity of
a place is not the worker's responsibility to instill and enforce, but is the duty of the
manager and the head. The workers only follow his lead, whether good or bad. Yet the quandary
of my people I know, and their distress I understand. Thus, if one endures for the sake
of their family, this is acceptable with me, for they have endured suffering for the sake of those
put under their care. However, if they depart for the sake of their integrity, and no longer wish
to endure the world and its corrupt ways, this too is acceptable with me, for whether one abides
or whether one departs, they remain in my love. Yet that which is unacceptable with me,
is it not written for them in the scriptures and volumes of truth? Therefore, when one of
my flock is not in danger, it is for them to discern and decide accordingly. I am the Lord.
